question: Which of the following organisations received the 2025 Zayed Sustainability Prize in the Health category in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Periwinkle Technologies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Periwinkle Technologies** received the **2025 Zayed Sustainability Prize** in the Health category in **January 2025**, recognizing their innovative contributions to the healthcare sector.
 
• This award is part of the prestigious **Zayed Sustainability Prize**, which honors organizations and individuals making impactful contributions to sustainability across categories such as health, energy, food, and water.
 
• Periwinkle Technologies is known for its pioneering work in medical diagnostics, particularly in developing solutions that are accessible and affordable for underserved communities.
 
• The organization specializes in technologies aimed at early detection of diseases, including cervical cancer, leveraging advanced imaging techniques and artificial intelligence.
 
• Their innovations have significantly enhanced healthcare delivery and disease prevention, particularly in regions with limited access to medical facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Zayed Sustainability Prize:**

 
 
• Named after **Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan**, the founding father of the United Arab Emirates, this prize aims to reward organizations and individuals contributing to global sustainability.
 
• Established in **2008**, it covers categories such as health, energy, food, and water, and provides financial grants to accelerate impactful solutions.
 
• Recipients are chosen based on innovation, impact, and inspiration in their respective fields.
 
 
 
• **Periwinkle Technologies:**
 
 
• Periwinkle Technologies is an **Indian organization** focused on advancing healthcare through innovative diagnostic solutions.
 
• It specializes in AI-driven medical imaging tools for early disease detection, particularly targeting cervical cancer and other life-threatening conditions.
 
• Their solutions are designed to be cost-effective, enabling better access to healthcare in rural and underserved areas.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees:**
 
 
• **Doctors Without Borders:** An international humanitarian organization providing medical aid in conflict zones, epidemics, and disasters.
 
• **Last Mile Health:** Focuses on delivering healthcare to remote and underserved populations, especially in Africa.
 
• **PATH:** A global nonprofit working to accelerate health equity through innovation and partnerships.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Periwinkle Technologies:**
 
 
• Periwinkle's innovations have reduced diagnostic costs, making healthcare more accessible to marginalized communities.
 
• Their technologies contribute to early disease detection, significantly improving patient outcomes and reducing mortality rates.
 
• They have collaborated with healthcare providers and governments to scale their solutions globally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Global Recognition:** The **Zayed Sustainability Prize** is considered one of the most prestigious awards in sustainability, offering winners financial support and global exposure.
 
• **Healthcare Innovation:** Periwinkle Technologies' focus on affordable diagnostics aligns with global goals to improve universal healthcare access.
 
• **AI Applications in Healthcare:** Their use of artificial intelligence for medical imaging is a significant step towards modernizing healthcare delivery systems.
 
• **Social Impact:** By addressing the healthcare gap in rural and underserved areas, Periwinkle Technologies exemplifies how technology can drive social equity.
